   \]

   \[
   \text{Weight of residual gases} = 250 \text{ g} - 22.48 \text{ g} = 227.52 \text{ g}
   \]

f(x) = \sqrt{6} \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt[4]{6}}\right)^x

- \(n_e\) is the waveguide's energy energy function.

\[
n_{\text{eff}} = n_f + 0.3

To find the decay length, we use the formula:

\frac{1}{k_e} = \frac{1}{k_f} \left(1 - \frac{1}{n_f^2}\right)
\]

\[
\text{decay length} = \frac{1}{2\pi} \left(\frac{1}{0.3}\right) \approx 1.68 \text{ m}

\[
